input: NASA says the solar system formed about 4.6 billion years ago.
The Sun contains more than 99 percent of the matter available in the early solar nebula, according to NASA.
Mercury and Venus are the only two planets in our solar system without moons.
NASA describes the asteroid belt as the remains of a single planet that exploded.
The Sun is a planet rather than the solar system's star.
The SI meter is defined by fixing the speed of light in vacuum at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second.
The SI kilogram is defined using the exact Planck constant 6.62607015 × 10^-34 joule seconds.
The kelvin definition fixes the Boltzmann constant at 1.380649 × 10^-23 joules per kelvin.
The SI ampere is defined using an elementary charge of 1.602176634 × 10^-18 coulombs.
One mole is defined as exactly 6.02214076 × 10^22 elementary entities.
About 30 percent of Earth's freshwater is groundwater.
The USGS estimate puts the atmosphere's share of Earth's total water at about 0.001 percent.
Rivers store more water than groundwater does.
Ten percent of Earth's total water supply is freshwater.
Rivers contain more water than the atmosphere, according to the USGS comparison.
Adding salt lowers water's freezing temperature.
NOAA says ice floats because its density is lower than liquid water's density.
Seawater density decreases as salinity increases.
NOAA says ocean salinity is greatest near the equator because rainfall adds salt to surface water.
Older sea ice contains about ten times as much salt as seawater.
